correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact iterated linear-fractional generating function f^t(s)=(t-(t-1)s)/(t+1-ts), giving P(Z_t>=h)=1/(t+1)*(t/(t+1))^(h-1). Independently verified PGF at a rational argument through 31 generations and evaluated cohort exceedance intensities for n=16000 (finite expected exceedances ~0.61; slow convergence to 1 is expected). For k~nu/lambda, rare-event sum Riemann limit is e^-x*u^alpha*exp(-u)/Gamma(alpha+1); polynomial envelope controls early cohort and exponential suppression late founders; triangular Bernoulli events have max probability o(1), sum squares o(1). These give a marked Poisson process with a continuous unique top point. E Z_t=1, Var(Z_t)=2t makes S_n variance O(n^(alpha+2)) and mean ~ c n^(alpha+1)/(alpha+1); alpha>0 ensures L2 concentration. Boundary t=0 clan handled separately; constant alpha=0 not claimed.
